intro: Outage Thursday! While Microsoft 365 went dark, our guy turned the @MSFT365Status replies into a full-blown comedy special, then moved his "official business" over to the Stocktwits SPY board. Clippy would be proud.

items.caption: The people have spoken: 378 likes for the case that Clippy would've had this outage handled hours ago. Justice for the paperclip!
items.quote: @MSFT365Status Clippy could have fixed this 3 hours ago.

items.caption: Every one of us during the outage, mashing refresh on Microsoft's X page. He said what we were all doing.
items.quote: @MSFT365Status Me refreshing microsofts X account page

items.caption: Taking notes from the status updates so he can someday say something without saying anything at all. A master studying the craft.
items.quote: @MSFT365Status Me writing this slop down to use at a later time when I want to say something without saying anything at all.

items.caption: Asking CoPilot nicely to boot up the email servers and getting the classic HAL treatment. Sci-fi reference game strong.
items.quote: @MSFT365Status Boot up the email servers CoPilot!  “I can’t do that Dave”

items.caption: Defending the Sunflower State's honor the only way he knows how: by insisting Kansas never punches above its weight. Peak home-state humility.
items.quote: @ManhattanHell You take that back! Kansas never punches above its weight at anything, on any level!

items.caption: Outlook down? No problem. The company simply relocated its official business to the SPY board. Business continuity planning at its finest.
items.quote: $SPY With outlook down, my company will conduct it's official business on the Stocktwits SPY board.

items.caption: Two weeks out and the traders are already prepping for Thanksgiving. His top-liked Stocktwits post of the day!
Too big-brained for the morning crowd. Some posts just need a second cup of coffee to land.
items.quote: $SPY This post was too cerebral for 9AM on the SPY board!
